instructions: Look at the image and decide whether the main food item shown is a hot dog. Answer hotdog only if a hot dog (sausage in a bun) is clearly the subject; anything else, including other sausages without a bun, sandwiches, burgers, or non-food images, is not_hotdog.

criteria.hotdog: A hot dog: a grilled or steamed sausage (frankfurter, wiener, bratwurst) served in a sliced bun, possibly with toppings such as mustard, ketchup, onions, relish, or sauerkraut. Several hot dogs on one plate also count.
criteria.not_hotdog: Anything that is not a hot dog: other foods (burgers, sandwiches, pizza, sausages without a bun, corn dogs, tacos, etc.), drinks, people, animals, objects, scenes, or images where no hot dog is visible.

state.task: Classify the food shown in the image
